prompt_meta.title: Venues Core (GA-grade): venues catalog + discover/search + attach venue to games (API + Web + Mobile)

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0008 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve the initial seeded venue set strategy for Korea wedge (what cities/areas and how many venues) described in ops/VENUE_RULES.md. Approval only; no execution.

step_objectives.goal: Introduce Venues as a first-class domain so Games can reference a canonical place, users can discover venues, and the product becomes location-realistic for Korea GA.
outcomes: Venues exist as a canonical catalog (seeded and retrievable)
Users can browse/search/filter venues (sport support + homeArea)
Games can be created/updated with an optional venueId (and show venue details on game detail pages)
Web + Mobile include venue browse + selection UX and are localized KO/EN
API contract and venue model are documented and stable for future steps (partner claiming, booking, maps)
constraints: No payments, no booking/reservations, no partner portal/claiming.
No external map SDK keys required. (Optional: store a mapLink string or optional lat/lng field for future use, but do not require a provider.)
Location handling must remain privacy-safe: use coarse administrative areas (e.g., city/gu/dong) and optional address text; do not require precise user GPS.
definition_of_done: IDE ensures Docker/infra is running (auto-start if needed) and migrations/seeds applied
API endpoints exist for venues list/search/detail and for setting a game's venueId; tests pass
Web: venues list/detail + venue picker integrated into game create/edit; tests cover key flows
Mobile: venues list/detail + venue picker integrated into game create/edit OR game edit (IDE decides; document parity plan if any deferral)
Docs created/updated: ops/VENUE_MODEL.md, ops/VENUE_RULES.md, ops/GAME_VENUE_INTEGRATION.md, ops/API_CONTRACTS.md updated

deliverables_outcomes.goal: No owner execution; infra must be up for DB-backed venues.
requirements: Ensure Docker daemon is running (auto-start/install attempt as needed).
Ensure infra containers are up (compose up if needed).
Apply DB migrations required for venue models and game linkage.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes docker info + compose ps evidence (if used)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: A venue model that supports Korea reality and future expansion.
requirements: Venue must include at minimum: name, area fields (coarse), address text (optional), supported sports (many-to-many), and a type/category (IDE chooses).
Optional-but-recommended fields: amenities, images (urls), contact, mapLink, and status (ACTIVE only is fine for now).
Ensure stable IDs for venues and consistent response shapes.
acceptance_criteria: Docs describe all fields and intended future extensions (claiming/booking/maps)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Start with a small, believable seed set for Korea wedge.
requirements: Seed an initial set of venues (small but realistic). IDE decides size; document rationale.
Seed should be idempotent and safe to run repeatedly.
Seed includes KO/EN-friendly naming strategy (do not translate proper nouns incorrectly; document approach).
acceptance_criteria: Report includes the final seeded count and sample entries

requirements: Endpoints to list venues with pagination and stable ordering.
Filters at minimum: sportId, area (homeArea or similar), and free-text query (name).
Venue detail endpoint returns enough data for UI.
Input validation and safe error handling.
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover filtering, pagination stability, and detail retrieval
Error cases tested (bad sportId, invalid pagination cursor, etc.)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Games can reference venues and show them.
requirements: Game create/update supports optional venueId (validated).
Game detail returns linked venue summary (and optionally a denormalized snapshot if IDE prefers; document tradeoffs).
If game venue changes, record notifications for participants (store-only, reuse existing notification system).
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover: creating game with venueId; rejecting invalid venueId; reading game detail includes venue
Notification created on venue change (if implemented) is tested

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Users can browse venues and choose one for a game.
requirements: Venues list + venue detail pages exist.
Game create/edit flow includes a venue picker (browse/search/select).
All visible text localized KO/EN via shared dictionary.
acceptance_criteria: Web tests cover venue list render and selecting venue in game flow
Onboarding gating still enforced where appropriate

requirements: Mobile venues list + venue detail screens exist.
Venue selection integrated into game create/edit OR at least game creation (IDE decides). If any part deferred, document precisely with next-step parity plan.
All visible text localized KO/EN via shared dictionary.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile tests cover rendering venues list/detail and selection state management headlessly
Manual run evidence documented (how to see venues + pick one)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Prepare for partner claiming + booking later without redesign.
requirements: Create ops/VENUE_MODEL.md describing schema, relationships, and future fields.
Create ops/VENUE_RULES.md describing seeding strategy, area strategy, and naming/localization approach.
Create ops/GAME_VENUE_INTEGRATION.md describing how games attach venues and what UI/UX rules apply.
Update ops/API_CONTRACTS.md accordingly.

tasks.name: Ensure infra running (executor-owned)
tasks.objective: Auto-start Docker/infra and confirm DB connectivity.
acceptance: docker + infra running OR BLOCKED with exact OS/permission limitation

tasks.name: Venue model + migrations + seed
tasks.objective: Add venue models, migrations, and idempotent seed for initial venues.
acceptance: migrations applied; seed idempotent; tests pass

tasks.name: Venues API + tests
tasks.objective: List/search/detail endpoints with pagination and filters.
acceptance: API tests cover filters + pagination stability

tasks.name: Games ↔ Venues integration + tests
tasks.objective: Attach venueId to games, return venue on game detail, notify on changes (store-only).

tasks.name: Web + Mobile UX
tasks.objective: Add venue browse/detail and integrate venue selection into game flow.

tasks.name: Docs + manifest + report
tasks.objective: Write docs, update manifest, produce complete report.
acceptance: Docs complete; manifest updated; report complete

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0008.report.json with no placeholders.
